active_pair_mask.reason: RTL generates every pair and every return node using NP, not image active mask. Fewer configured live pairs alone cannot remove parent state or prove synthesis pruning.

aggregate_scaling: At fixed aggregate compiled pair capacity, fewer pairs per die lower per-die storage but replicated root contexts add a fixed positive per-die intercept. No aggregate storage saving or token speedup follows automatically. Existing reference partition counts are parameter arithmetic, not compiled ownership.

decision.priority: DSROM fixed4096/fewer-complete-element reticle proof; archived HBM draft deferred.

equations.meaning: 138469120bits is exact NP8192/R128 declared lower bound, not an irreducible fixed workload storage demand. It remains reserved for that compiled topology; source controls, adders and mux/clock costs are extra.

exact_once_scope.field_parent: g_lv.u_n and g_r.u_root are outside pair hierarchy, counted once as global return. No named mapped-provider proof demonstrates they are already inside historical slot pricing.
exact_once_scope.generic_return_adder: Replace earlier approximate return-adder model with exact source count; never add both.
exact_once_scope.pair_local: Pair-local chain/segment state belongs to element slot.

VM_edge_contract.collision_obligation: Same-address root writes or later NBA assignments by ME/SU/reducer/vector/other writers can overwrite; require sourcecalendar no same-address conflicting writer and correct VM_AW truncation/address bounds.
VM_edge_contract.implicit_acceptance: No explicit ACK; retained behavioral tile schedules every rom_we write atnextposedge. Consumer reads in same block sample pre-NBA VM.
VM_edge_contract.physical_requirement: Real VM must deliver128 independently addressed32bit writes/cycle atthese edges or model additional service/buffer/latency; no finite port/route qualification inferred from behavioral array.
VM_edge_contract.source: tile lines552..556 directrom_we array writes in clocked block; core lines1176..1180 spine wiring. Exact source hash pinned; line labels informational.

contracts.accept: posedge a_v/b_v writes aw/bw; overflow if oldcount==64 and no corresponding pop
contracts.ports: Per node two independent65bit writes and two independent65bit reads can coincide;16.25B write+16.25B read/cycle. One logical output/cycle; two reads needed for sibling add.
contracts.release: same posedge pop_a/pop_b samples old head into the addition or by_v path; ar/br increments. Storage lifetime ends at capture, downstream value lifetime continues. Local sameedge pop+write uses old read/NBA write semantics.
contracts.reuse_guard: Only local free circular slots proven by ac/bc and pop; no cross-node storage ownership/ACK.

contracts.accept: pop transfers a forward or sibling addition; add launches two operands
contracts.ports: Independent from input queue read/writes; payload/tag/error pipeline widths and all internal fadd intermediate registers require separate physical ledger
contracts.release: by_v/vp output followed by RST valid captured by parent FIFO/root on freeclk
contracts.reuse_guard: ap[3] prevents a bypass collision with an add result. Queue empty is insufficient: ap/vp/by_v/RST valid may still own data. Element clock gating does not clock these return registers.

contracts.accept: i_v writes qw; overflow if oldqc==128&&!use_q
contracts.ports: One65bit write+one65bit read per root may coincide; result priority suppresses read. 128 roots cannot become one shared port by capacity accounting.
contracts.release: use_q=!sv&&qc!=0 selects old queue head into complete/held/add path
contracts.reuse_guard: Only FIFO local free-slot recurrence; root sibling storage and adder may be simultaneously live.

contracts.accept: cv&&!complete&&!hit&&fr>=0 sets bv and stores bt/bd/be
contracts.ports: 128-way tag compare, lowesthit/free priority; one selected read and one write path. No global ACK or pointer shared with root FIFO.
contracts.release: hit consumes old held sibling, clears bv and registers add_a/add_b/tag_in; source add launches nextedge
contracts.reuse_guard: Nonmatching tags can live until a much later sibling. No finite timeout releases them. Empty inputFIFO/rootrow retirement does not imply bv==0.

contracts.accept: cv&&complete produces registered r_v plus row/pos/FP32/BF16/error
contracts.release: spine samples r_v on next freeclk edge; no ready or ACK pin
contracts.reuse_guard: Retire transfers into write command, not confirmed VM visibility; exact-once tags plus root/pipeline quiet needed before phase reuse.

contracts.accept: r_v samples into registered w_we/w_addr[19]/w_data[32]; rows_left decrements simultaneously
contracts.ports: 128 writes/cycle required; no w_ready/ACK on spine interface
contracts.release: Retained tile direct array: next freeclk edge after registered w_we captures VM write; visible after NBA and to synchronous reader one further edge, conditional on no competing same-address laterwrite. Physical provider/calendar service still needs joined proof.
contracts.reuse_guard: Implicit always-accept service is an obligation, not a demonstrated ACK. rows_left==0&&!sm_run&&!ld_run or fieldbusy==0 is not evidence of last write visibility or all return state empty.

lifetimes_and_ports.legal_reuse: Only existing local FIFO slots released by old-head capture/pop and root held slots released by sibling capture. Pipeline value remains live. No cross-owner scratch pool/address alias/ACK exists in current source.
lifetimes_and_ports.same_edge_read_write: Local old-data capture before NBA overwrite is necessary; cross-owner sharing also requires simultaneous independent read/write ports and source latency equivalence.

parameter_change_obligations: Compile-bind actual power-of-two NP/R/NBF full topology and all padded complete elements; no arbitrary2966-node geometry or active-only return surrogate.
Re-emit every affected bank/config/ROM/program phase under fixed4096 PP macro geometry, preserving aggregate payload, compute contexts and exact row/segment/position tags and golden order.
Prove per-pair NSEG8/class/FIFO and ROM depth capacity; reduced NP can increase work and live backlog per pair. A per-die tree capacity reduction is not workload occupancy proof.
Resolve actual BF site map and preserve1024 BF pairs/128 row ports; image relocation is a mandatory source binding gate.
Join actual arrival skew, node/root occupancy, leaf DRAIN127, freeclock return quiet, all write visibility and dependent consumer reads to Maxwell calendar.
Price extra die instances/links/serial service latency and all omitted return logic before reticle fit or adoption; no physical or token qualification from parameter arithmetic.
